scope: Read-only derived measurements from frozen 64-chain existing-field plan; no MC or source archive changes.
protocol_update: Dense scalar + sparse field observations share physical time blocks. The earlier pilot checkpoint-only protocol is retained as a sensitivity comparison.
time_alignment: Each field at t=100k is paired with scalar mean over t-99,...,t. No G replication or interpolation. Same contiguous bin-block draws for G and all scalar columns, independently within each MC start; row-weighted pooling.

crossing.observables: Direct R and log ensemble G, not interpolation of individual configuration logs.
crossing.root_rule: Exactly one supported crossing, else missing/ambiguous; at least .99 common-valid draw fraction for resolved label. No branch selection or clipping.
crossing.estimators: Separate Delta_quarter, Delta_half, Delta_m2 with full same-draw covariance and paired differences. No asymptotic extrapolation from only two pairs.

limitations: Spatial sites/axes are not independent MC events.
G remains limited to retained regular checkpoints; scalar density does not add G observations.
Few conservative time blocks make bootstrap coverage conditional.
Fixed-q slope and finite-pair quotients do not certify CFT Delta, mixing, or systematic error.
Earlier full-history m2 estimate is not paired with unrelated bootstrap draws.
checks: 28 focused measurement/common-R tests passed, including independent analytic GLS covariance and incomplete-support report paths.
